new_components: Only add focused shared prototype-aligned components when at least two route screens share the same behavior contract.
reused_components: atomic Button, IconButton, Badge, Icon, Error, Warning
form InputField, SelectField, Checkbox, RadioField and editors
layout Container, Panel, Popup, Settings, Scaffold, Header, Tabs
ops DeploymentNav, InfrastructureNav, OpsMetricCard, OpsMetricPanel, OpsSectionNav, OpsSparkline, PrototypeIcon
Pinia repository, pipeline, server, application, and deployment stores
extraction_triggers: same prototype page-header/action pattern appears in two route families
same loading, pagination, stale-request, mutation, or subscription state machine repeats
page-local component owns more than one user-facing responsibility
forbidden_dependencies: atomic, form, and layout components importing API clients or Pinia domain stores
frontend components importing Go server or datastore modules
page-local CSS creating a second token system
production components importing standalone prototype fixtures or state
hooks: reuse existing useTheme, useI18n, useApiClient, useAsyncAction, useDate, usePaginate, usePipeline, useRouteBack and authentication/config compositions
extract new headless behavior only after repeated real consumers are confirmed
utilities: reuse existing pipeline, repository metrics, date, formatting, and status utilities
add invalid date/duration normalization at the shared formatting boundary when confirmed
required_component_tests: shared component render and emitted intent variants
theme/i18n and 390px responsive visual checks for completed slices
